learning_outcomes.text: Students will have an overview of the different properties of generation plants from renewable sources and know their detailed functionality.
Students will apply calculation methods and simulation software to solve standard and advanced tasks.
Students will create concepts for extensive power supply from renewable sources and calculate the important parameters for assessment.
The concepts will be subjected to a critical analysis and evaluation regarding their feasibility, safety, and economic viability.

syllabus_topics: Technical and economic properties of electrical energy sources
Photovoltaics and Solar Thermal Power Plants
Secondary energy conversion in combined heat and power plants
Secondary energy conversion in fuel cells
Measurements on the wind power teaching experiment with doubly fed asynchronous machine
Simulation programs for calculating solar systems

assessment_methods.method: graded written assignment (Hausarbeit) or written exam (Klausur)

assessment_rules: The form of examination (graded written assignment or written exam) will be determined at the beginning of the semester; a written assignment is the standard. The graded written assignment should be 10-20 pages long, possibly with an associated explanation of approx. 20 minutes. The ungraded experimental work consists of 3-4 experiments.
